Implemented the member-level primary-key one-to-one foreign-key binding correction. ToOneBinder now reads PrimaryKeyJoinColumn.foreignKey and delegates PrimaryKeyJoinColumns to the existing container resolver. Ordinary JoinColumn/JoinColumns precedence and shared constraint handling remain unchanged. No helper redesign, public signatures, classifications, persisted formats or unrelated files changed.

Alberto Michele supplied the report and inline LAZY/nonoptional association examples in HHH-20763. The new regression test adapts those mappings into new test entities and verifies metadata after schema export: single NO_CONSTRAINT, requested name, default constraint, separate plural container NO_CONSTRAINT/name, nested-column name, and unchanged ordinary JoinColumn name/suppression. The historical 6.6 example used a removed Hibernate annotation; no claim is made that the standard Jakarta annotation previously worked.
